name: haiku-100k
description: Haiku cost tools: keep every Haiku request under the 100k-token price step, and the haiku-build workflow on top of it.

plugins.name: haiku-100k
plugins.description: Keeps every Haiku request under the 100k-token price step (agent, setup command, guard hook), ships the haiku-build workflow skill (v2) and its unattended variant haiku-build-auto, the subagent-model-router skill (off by default), and agent-reliability (retry-loop guard with Opus escalation, observe by default).
